constraints: required inputs must exist and be non-empty
caption occlusion requires proxy, caption style, and transcript
analysis outputs are observations, not executable edit authority
Phase 2 never invokes planning, compilation, or Resolve
cookies, credentials, tokens, and full environment values are not serialized

phase2.cache_identity: analyzer script hash + actual configured interpreter identity + deterministic argv profile hash + required input hashes
phase2.caption_occlusion_bundle: primary JSON + every declared required event manifest + every expected non-empty mask frame; zero requested masks require no sidecars; optional debug/audit excluded
